entities.name: Thomas H. Eliot
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas Hopkinson Eliot was an American lawyer, politician, and academic who served as chancellor of Washington University in St. Louis and as a congressman in the United States House of Representatives from Massachusetts.
